# aronia

> An agent-friendly design language delivered shadcn-style: `npx aronia add` copies real component source (tokens, styles, a thin framework skin) plus a machine-readable manifest into a project's repo. Point an agent at the manifest and it can use every component correctly from the schema alone.

Three design-language families, 20 components each: `neo-brutalism` (bold, high-contrast, hard shadows), `glassmorphism` (frosted, layered — needs a non-uniform backdrop), and `swiss` (clean, grid-driven minimalism, a single hazard-orange accent). A component's contract is the same across frameworks; only a ~30-line skin differs, selected via `--framework react|svelte|html`.

## Registry

- [Full manifest](/manifest.json): every style, component, prop, enum, and behaviour in one document — each style also carries `principles` (how to compose tastefully in that design language), `avoid` (anti-patterns), `composition` (page-level type scale, spacing ramp, breakpoints, container, and media treatment), and `fontGuidance` (how to swap the family's typeface without dissolving its character)
- [Neo-Brutalism manifest](/neo-brutalism/manifest.json): the neo-brutalism family only
- [Glassmorphism manifest](/glassmorphism/manifest.json): the glassmorphism family only
- [Swiss manifest](/swiss/manifest.json): the swiss family only
- [Registry index](/r/index.json): every per-component item and the frameworks it ships
- Per-component item — `/r/{style}/{component}.json`: embeds the prop spec, tokens, component CSS, and every framework skin

## Docs

- [Guide](/guide): how to add components and point your agent at them
- [Home](/): overview and live component playgrounds

## Companion skills

aronia's `composition` covers only per-style identity; universal design hygiene (typography, UI polish, color) is delegated to [jakubkrehel/skills](https://github.com/jakubkrehel/skills) — `npx skills add jakubkrehel/skills`. Use both together.
